Hello,

Thank you for thinking of us for this project, and for the details on the scope.

We can certainly look at preferential pricing for a multi-site framework booking of that size, but a 22% reduction is beyond what any of our regional managers can approve directly - our discount authority tops out at 15% at that level, and anything higher has to go through our Managing Director.

If you can send over the full scope (sites, equipment list, expected duration), we'll put together a proposal within what we can approve here and flag your request for the additional discount to management for a decision. We'll come back to you as soon as we hear back.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

We're sorry for the frustration here, and for the delay in getting this sorted.

You're right - when we have to cancel a confirmed booking because of an equipment breakdown on our side, our policy is a full refund of anything paid, plus a 10% goodwill credit toward a future rental. We can see this wasn't processed after the cancellation, and we're arranging it now: the full refund will be issued to your original payment method, along with the 10% goodwill credit applied to your account, without further delay.

We appreciate your patience, and thank you for flagging it - this shouldn't have taken this long.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy

Hi Teemu,

Thanks for raising this, and we understand it's frustrating. That said, damage charges are assessed against our repair-cost schedule and, once they've been worked out and sent to you, our policy is that they're final - we're not able to waive or renegotiate them after the event, even for a long-standing customer. So the 260 EUR charge on booking RB-20262082 stands.

If you think the damage was there before you picked the compactor up, let us know and we can check that against our check-out photos and inspection record - that's the one situation where a charge like this would be reversed.

We're still checking the Kempele schedule for your date change on this booking too and will come back to you with available dates shortly.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy
